vecUnachieved.strDescription: Get a Food & Service Quality rating of 50 for a food stand.
Avoid "Terrible Burger" feedback for 10 days in a row.
Have a day with all positive feedback.
Maintain a gross profit margin of 50% or more for 10 days straight!
Go a week without "Long Wait Time" feedback.
Sell 1,000 burgers with one company in one playthrough.
Buy your first Startup Burger Bike.
Go a week without "Slow Service" feedback.
Sell 1,000 drinks with one company in one playthrough.
Get a Food & Service Quality rating of 75 for a food stand.

data.strFullDescription: [p]You sell, make money, or not. [b]It's all about strategy[/b]: what to prioritise, when to raise prices or go into a price war with your competitor, and much more. An oversight might cost you a few bucks or millions. You keep lines moving. You outsmart rivals, ride the good days, and survive the bad ones. [b]A tycoon/management simulation about starting small, getting better, and making it big.[/b][/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1429080/extras/ea66bd3ac05c846916d00ec229f686ab.poster.avif?t=1768498799" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1429080/extras/ea66bd3ac05c846916d00ec229f686ab.webm?t=1768498799" width="766" height="300"][/imgvid][/p][h2]Master Lee's challenge[/h2][p][img width="766" height="298"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1429080/extras/c30d2ea0aae6f10b3671348a74140075.avif?t=1768498799[/img][/p][p]Every morning, the richest entrepreneur alive sips Yorkshire tea and thinks about the one thing he never found: a true successor. So, he builds a test anyone can try. A business challenge based on one of his first hustles. He calls it Business Heroes: Street Grub. Pass his challenge, and you prove you've got the heart and the brains to lead.[/p][h2]Your mission[/h2][p]Start a food-truck business that lasts. Grow so fast that it bothers your rivals. Meet the hidden conditions Master Lee set along the way. If you go bankrupt, you lose. If you stay sharp, you rise.[/p][h2]What will you do?[/h2][list][*][p]Create burger recipes people want to buy.[/p][/*][*][p]Set prices that feel fair or not... but make you money.[/p][/*][*][p]Plan upgrades and expansion without going bankrupt.[/p][/*][*][p]Spend on marketing when it matters.[/p][/*][*][p]Hire, train, and keep your team steady.[/p][/*][*][p]React to weather, events, and a changing economy.[/p][/*][/list][p][img width="616" height="118"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1429080/extras/83971b1d7138437411592b248008fe02.avif?t=1768498799[/img][/p][p]At night, you make decisions: strategy, pricing, upgrades, hiring, marketing.[/p][p]By day, you watch it play out on the street. Queues, rushes, reviews, surprises. No fluff. Just your decisions, working... or not.[/p][h2]Intense moments you'll remember[/h2][list][*][p]Selling out right before sunset.[/p][/*][*][p]Flipping a price war and winning the crowd back.[/p][/*][*][p]Catching glowing reviews that make tomorrow's line longer.[/p][/*][*][p]Riding an economic boom and opening the next stand.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Who is it for?[/h2][p]Players who like strategy. If management games calm your brain and good decisions make your day, you'll feel at home here. This is perfect to play while working or studying. Decide, press Play, and come back a few minutes later to see how the day went.[/p][p][/p][p]--[/p][p]While we don't use AI for art generation, we do embrace it as an assistive tool to improve our workflow. We use AI-powered features for code prediction to streamline development and to help us review, shorten, and simplify our writing for better clarity.[/p]
data.strSnippet: Start broke on a burger bike. Build your fortune by selling... well... just burgers. Outsmart rivals, ride economic booms, feel in control and powerful as your strategies begin to show results. A tycoon/management game about starting small, getting better, and making it big.
